title: iMathBook · uMathHub
description: This was the first project he contributed to—one into which he poured his passion for product design while sharpening his engineering craft in practice. In May 2025, he joined ProbFun, the predecessor of uMathHub; that July, he started an independent branch, formed the iMathBook project team, and led its development. Today, both iMathBook and uMathHub are officially recognized mathematics teaching platforms at BUPT, deployed in active coursework with more than 1,000 student engagements in total.
role: ProbFun contributor · formed the iMathBook team and led development
